name: 13662 · Massena, NY
findings: ZIP 13662 (Massena) has 50 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 13662 (Massena) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 13662 (Massena) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
